stories.title: Sam Altman's testimony begins in Musk trial
stories.summary: OpenAI CEO Sam Altman takes the stand to defend his company against a lawsuit brought by Elon Musk.

stories.title: Farmers want firm trade deal from Trump's China visit
stories.summary: President Trump's state visit to China will be closely watched in the American heartland, where his trade war has resulted in grain farmers losing considerable business from international buyers.

stories.title: Cure for Paranoia shares what it took to win's this year's Tiny Desk Contest
stories.summary: NPR's Ailsa Chang speaks with Cameron McCloud of the band Cure for Paranoia, which won this year's Tiny Desk Contest.

stories.title: Inflation is up. Americans explain how it's affecting them
stories.summary: Consumer prices surged 3.8% in April from a year ago, according to the Labor Department. We hear from people who are feeling the effects of inflation and how they're dealing.

stories.title: The clipping economy: How short-form video 'clippers' are overrunningthe internet
stories.summary: Turning long-form podcasts and interviews into short-form social media clips has become a lucrative career for some. But others say it is a race to the bottom.

stories.title: In '2084,' authors fictionalize global threats as a real world warning
stories.summary: NPR's Mary Louise Kelly talks to Admiral James Stavridis and Elliot Ackerman about their new book, 2084, which examines a future where climate change has ravaged the planet.
